decisions.reason: The placeholder role and video URL are already fully represented by the candidate's message-96 MODIFY, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Selecting a temporary gallery video asset does not change the gallery's browsing mode, tabs, or content organization.
The temporary video asset does not change the requirement to associate relevant images with listed services.
The video asset choice does not change the homepage design direction, hero-image emphasis, or blue overlay settings.
The temporary video asset is unrelated to itemized service pricing presentation or coverage.
The video selection does not affect package counts, square-footage categories, or package prices.
Providing a temporary media asset does not change the domain, hosting provider, CMS, or control-panel requirements.
The placeholder video does not alter gallery hover-animation behavior on desktop or mobile.
The source selects a video asset and does not change the rules governing client-supplied photographs or their placement.
The temporary video asset does not change the required animation level for the homepage gallery.
The video asset and its placeholder status do not change any homepage button destination.
The source does not change the requirement for homepage portfolio tiles to link to the Gallery page.
